prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「邀请」？
explanation: invitation 的意思是邀请。

prompt: 「preparation」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: preparation 的意思是准备。

prompt: 选择表示「音乐会」的单词。
explanation: 表示音乐会的单词是 concert。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「有空的」？
explanation: available 的意思是有空的。

prompt: 邀请对方来聚会，哪一句正确？

choices.text: Can you to come to my party?
Do you can come to my party?
Can you coming to my party?
Can you come to my party?

explanation: Can you 后面用动词原形。

prompt: 你很乐意去，哪一句正确？

choices.text: Sure, I will love to went.

explanation: would love to 后面省略了 come。

prompt: 那天你得去看医生，哪一句正确？

choices.text: I have to seeing the doctor.
I have to see the doctor.
I has to see the doctor.

explanation: have to 后面用动词原形。

prompt: Can you come to the concert? 这句主要是在做什么？
explanation: Can you come 常用来邀请。

prompt: 对方邀请你星期六来，你能来，应怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I am available on Saturday.
Sure. I was available on Saturday tomorrow.
Sure. I am available in Saturday.

explanation: on Saturday，并且要有 am。

prompt: 你不能去，因为要准备考试。哪一句合适？

choices.text: Sorry, I have to preparing for a test.

verify: "Sorry, I have to prepare for a test."

prompt: 想问对方星期二是否有空，哪一句合适？
explanation: 星期前用 on，available 前面用 are。

prompt: 对方说 I might have to meet my friend. 这是什么意思？
explanation: might have to 表示可能不得不。

prompt: Please come to my party on Sunday at 7. It is at my house. 聚会在星期几？
explanation: on Sunday。

prompt: Please come to my party on Sunday at 7. It is at my house. 在哪里举行？
explanation: at my house。

prompt: Anna can come. Jeff has to prepare for a test, so he cannot come. 谁不能来？
explanation: Jeff cannot come。

choices.text: Jeff is not available because of a test.
Jeff will come to the party.

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「建议」？
explanation: advice 的意思是建议。

prompt: 「organize」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: organize 的意思是组织。

prompt: 选择表示「心烦的」的单词。
explanation: 表示心烦的的单词是 upset。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「粗心的」？
explanation: careless 的意思是粗心的。

prompt: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家里。哪一句正确？

choices.text: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, I stayed at home.
If it rain tomorrow, I will stay at home.

explanation: if 从句用 rains，主句用 will stay。
verify: "If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home."

prompt: 如果你去聚会，你会玩得很开心。哪一句正确？

choices.text: If you will go to the party, you have a great time.
If you go to the party, you will have a great time.
If you go to the party, you had a great time.
If you went to the party, you will have a great time tomorrow.

explanation: 从句 go，主句 will have。
verify: "If you go to the party, you will have a great time."

prompt: if 条件从句表示将来时，动词常用哪一种时态？
explanation: 条件从句里通常不用 will。

prompt: 如果他来，请告诉我。哪一句正确？

choices.text: If he will come, please tell me.
If he come, please tell me.
If he comes, please told me.
If he comes, please tell me.

explanation: he 后面用 comes，祈使句用 tell。

If you eats too much, you will feel sick.

如果今天开聚会会发生什么

prompt: 朋友很心烦，你想建议他离开吵闹的聚会。哪一句合适？

choices.text: If you leave now, you will feel better.

prompt: If you wear jeans, the teacher will not let you in. If you take a bus, you will be late. 穿牛仔裤会怎样？

prompt: If you wear jeans, the teacher will not let you in. If you take a bus, you will be late. 坐公交会怎样？
explanation: you will be late。

prompt: If we organize the games well, everyone will have fun. 大家会玩得开心的条件是什么？
